name: lib/crypto
description: Ciphers (AES/DES/Blowfish/CAST/IDEA/Twofish/ARC4), hashes (MD5/SHA1/SHA256/SHA3/Keccak), public-key (RSA/DSA/DH), big numbers, CSPRNG (Fortuna), ASN.1 / X.509.
residual: DES and Checksum entered 2026-08-24, unclaimed until then: DES belongs beside the other ciphers, and Checksum (GF) is the md5/sha1/sha3 command over the hashes already here.

Moved out of std/ 2026-08-27 by the Rust border (docs/STDLIB.md): the standard library holds what packages talk to each other through; this is a leaf that ob get can deliver. Sources still live in source/ -- only the classification moved. `headless` false keeps it out of the SDK payload.
